## Seedance 2.5 Flash API

Seedance 2.5 Flash is a text to video, image to video, reference to video and video editing model by ByteDance Seed, available on the Venice API as `seedance-2-5-flash-text-to-video-basic`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Seedance 2.5 Flash is a faster version of ByteDance Seed's Seedance 2.5, with native audio. This text-to-video variant generates 4- to 30-second clips at up to 720p.

### Seedance 2.5 Flash API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seedance-2-5-flash-text-to-video-basic` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.0879 / sec |
| `seedance-2-5-flash-image-to-video-basic` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.084 / sec |
| `seedance-2-5-flash-reference-to-video-basic` | Reference to video | Anonymized | from $0.0879 / sec |
| `seedance-2-5-flash-edit-video-basic` | Video edit | Anonymized | priced by source |

Clip prices for `seedance-2-5-flash-text-to-video-basic`, silent:

| Duration | 480p | 720p |
|---|---|---|
| Per second | $0.0879 | $0.19 |
| 4s | $0.35 | $0.76 |
| 5s | $0.44 | $0.95 |
| 10s | $0.88 | $1.90 |
| 30s | $2.64 | $5.70 |

Any length from 4 to 30 seconds, priced per second.

### Seedance 2.5 Flash specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | ByteDance Seed |
| Released | Nov 14, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Modes | text to video, image to video, reference to video and video editing |
| Resolutions | 720p, 480p |
| Durations | 4–30s, any whole second |
| Aspect ratios | 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16 |
| Audio | Optional |

### How to use the Seedance 2.5 Flash API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "seedance-2-5-flash-text-to-video-basic"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "seedance-2-5-flash-text-to-video-basic",
```
